description: Virtual MIDI merger and splitter: it takes messages from two MIDI inputs and passes them to two MIDI outputs, filtering or rewriting the channel on the way.
notes: system messages pass through unchanged in every mode.
nothing passes until a device is picked for at least one input and one output on the displays.
menu: MIDI channel mode — on an output's own display menu: Replace channel, Filter to channel or Block channel, which is how that output treats the channel chosen below it.
MIDI channel — on an output's own display menu, the channel that Replace, Filter or Block applies to.
MIDI channel — on an input's own display menu, limiting that input to one channel before its messages reach the outputs.
Thru — the entry above the numbered channels on an output's own channel display menu; with it chosen that output passes every message unchanged and no channel mode applies.
